t: Reach the tower in the White Castle together with Ilya Dubinin and look for survivors.

Architects, you say? Never heard of them.

You're wondering what I'm doing here? Same as you - trying to find out what happened to the Hunters.

It must have been something really terrible if they had sent messengers both to the League and the Empire. Something must have gone wrong when they teleported and deranged them...

I think we should find the survivors and get out of here. Those Architects, whatever they are, pose a serious threat for all of us.
Go down! Come on, hurry up!
Who the hell are you?! Hands up and don't move! Now, who are you and what are you doing here?
Break to the White Fortress gates.

Is this for real? The League and the Empire fighting hand in hand! Looks like the messengers could make it after all.

So you say these stone monsters are called the Architects? They came out of nowhere in the middle of the night and completely destroyed our defenses. They even somehow wrecked our Portal and turned our Great Mage to dust when he tried to take us away from here. I sent two guys with Adventurer's Stones to deliver the messages and gave the order to fight to the bitter end. We won't give up just like that!

Alright, let's break through to the gates before it's too late!

You clashed with them on the bridge, right? Damn it. We thought we could stanch our wounds and break out of the fortress on our own. I can see that was hardly gonna work out.

Have you seen Lock? A huge fella, with a cracked tooth and shoulder straps. Loud-mouthed like a ship siren!

He died?.. Oh dear... May the Light rest his soul!
Reach the river bank, fetch water and bring it to Radovid Gloomov.

Hey, friend... I don't know what is your name.

There are not so many of us left. Radovid, our healer, is doing everything he can, but he needs water. I tried to get some, but those critters on the bank shoot me. I could hardly get away...

Will you help me? Take this flask and fetch some water in the river for Radovid. Watch out for the shooters!
Have you seen Nikolay Chilin? With a moustache and a headband. He went to fetch some water, and now there's no sign of him.
Water! Finally! The wounded are dying to have a sip.
Give enchanted water to 5 wounded soldiers in the White Fortress.

Wait, I will add some healing powder and a drop of water of life to the flask... Here you go!

Please, give it to those wounded who are still conscious. I'm trying to save those who already have one foot in the Purgatory.
The soldiers dying from wounds and thirst. The damned monsters destroyed all storehouses!

I hope this will help the wounded. I thought of putting an end to their suffering myself, but where would they have gone from the Purgatory? Right into the enemies' hands! Only Tensess knows what they could do to them.
Use the tower cannon to cover the soldiers who are trying to break to the White Fortress port and meet Radovid Gloomov near the pier.

What do we do now? The fortress has fallen, the commanders have died, and I'm just a healer! These people trust me because I mend their wounds, but I am no soldier!

I hate to say that, but we need to retreat. I can see the sails of our ship in the port! This is our last chance!

There are a lot of wounded soldiers here. Somebody has to cover us as we pass along the outer wall. If the monsters reach us, we're dead.

See that cannon on the wall? There's still energy in its batteries. Go there and blast every creature who tries to get in our way!
I swear on the new gods and the old gods - these monsters could not have been born in our world!

We hardly made it... I don't understand what is it they are trying to achieve, those... how do you call them? The Architects!

Why are they attacking us? What do they need? Do you know? Neither do I...
Find Seeress Unn in the fortress and protect her from the Architects.

I'm worried for Unn. She's a very powerful seeress, and gibberlings call her the Thread Mistress. Right before the assault she started writhing in hysterics, raving and screaming that the new order is coming! We have never seen her like that.

Our governor told two soldiers to escort her to the hospital. I went for some tranquilizers, and that's when we were attacked.

The hospital is right there, near the pier. Can you please make sure Unn survived? We have little hope, but still...

What's going on? I... I was dead, right? My Thread was cut, I can feel it! Now it's interlaced in the Fabric of Creation once again, but the Pattern... The Pattern has changed!

How?! How did you do it?!
Meet with Elizaveta Rysina in Nezebgrad.

I have an urgent message for you. Elizaveta Rysina demands you in her office, right now!

This is a mission of national importance!
Finally, here you are. You can participate in the interrogation, if our guest is able to answer any questions, of course.
Talk to Izbor Yavorsky in Novograd.

Urgent Message! From Izbor Yavorsky himself!

Izbor wishes to see you as soon as possible. This is a matter of a state importance!
Return to the White Fortress and help the Demon Hunters.
You have left the White Fortress. To return and resume the adventure, talk to Elizaveta Rysina in Yasker's Tower.
Elizaveta will send you back at any time. Just ask her.
Your mission at the White Fortress has been completed.
Return to the White Fortress and help the Demon Hunters.
You have left the White Fortress. To return and resume the adventure, talk to Izbor Yavorsky in Aidenus' Tower.
Izbor will send you back at any time. Just ask him.
Your mission at the White Fortress has been completed.
Complete the second round of June Catacombs or defeat the final boss on an Astral allod. Return to Zinaida Krichalkina for reward.

Greetings to the heroes! Do you wish to serve your motherland?

Golem races in June Catacombs are fun! And apart from fun, the winner gets a very valuable reward. We should participate in them, too. Let everyone know that our heroes are the fastest and the deftest in Sarnaut!

If you don't fancy speed racing, then just go to the Astral and deal with monsters on one of the allods!

Good luck in your deeds!
How is it going? Ah, I envy you so much! Day-to-day life of the heroes must be so exciting.

Excellent! Another day, another feat! Keep up the good work!

Let me remind you, that if you complete five of my quests in a week, you will receive a valuable prize!
Win a Goblinball match or complete the Path of Trials quest in Tka-Rik's Cave. Return to Zinaida Krichalkina.

Greetings to the heroes! Do you wish to serve your motherland?

Have you ever played Goblinball? If not, you should definitely try it! it is traditional orcish sports activity, and orcs know how to have fun!

If you don't fancy sports and rather commit feats on your own, then Tka-Rik's Cave is waiting for you with all sorts of trials!

Good luck in your deeds!
Win any Skirmish or complete any Distortion. Return to Zinaida Krichalkina.

Greetings to the heroes! Do you wish to serve your motherland?

Are you familiar with the thrill of real Skirmishes? When you descend upon the enemy shoulder to shoulder with your allies and clash in the fire of true battle? Go to the Battleground and see who's the strongest!

If you do not seek battle glory, you can gather your allies and set out to a Distortion. Finish several dangerous monsters that dwell there!

Good luck in your deeds!
Fight at the Arena of Death or complete the Astral Hunt quest, which is given by Nastassja Ushkuynikova in the Hangar. Return to Valya Skomorokhova.

Greetings to the heroes! Do you wish to serve your motherland?

Arena of Death is a battleground where every day two great armies fight in a thrilling battle. Those who prove their supremacy, win the treasures of the Arena and glory for their guild. Don't miss your chance to participate!

If you are interested in more exciting activities, gather your own team and set out on the Astral hunt! The head of Demon Hunters in the Hangar will reward you generously for that, and so will we.

Good luck in your deeds!
Kill 30 enemies in the Kingdom of Elements with your War Banner raised or reach the finish line in the race on Kirah. Return to Zinaida Krichalkina.

Greetings to the heroes! Do you wish to serve your motherland?

The League and the Empire have been sharing their interest in the Kingdom of Elements recently. Who knows how many secrets and ancient treasures it conceals? And there where the greatest enemies of Sarnaut have a common interest, a war breaks out inevitably. Go to the Kingdom of Elements and a help a group of researchers. But be ready to repel unexpected attacks!

If you are not interested in this kind of entertainment, I can suggest something else - like races on Kirah! Participating in them is worthwhile whether you win or not!

Good luck in your deeds!
Complete the daily quest "Not a Day without a Feat" 5 times. return to Zinaida Krichalkina.
No, you've come too soon. I've been counting your feats!
Complete the daily quest "Not a Day without a Feat" 5 times. return to Zinaida Krichalkina.

Here you are! Have you heard the news? We are calling on all the heroes and encourage them to commit daily feats for the benefit of our homeland! Peace and prosperity for the people, and honor and fun for the heroes! And some great rewards, too.

The conditions are simple. You will be rewarded for each feat you commit with something that will prove very useful in your travels. If you complete our quests 5 times in a row, we will generously pay you with gold and some powerful potions from the Boutique!

Don't miss your chance! This doesn't happen every day. It is quite tiresome to keep record of your deeds, you know.
One, two, three, four, five! Right, five feats, just as I asked. Isn't it good to feel so important?

Wait a minute! It's you I've been looking for! I heard about your adventures, and I know you're a champion. This is just what we need. What, don't you know what goes on here? We're getting ready for an Anniversary, whole Sarnaut is celebrating it.

By saying "we", I mean all members of the Holiday Committee and our chief, Brooser the Snap.

I've got stuff to do. If you want to help, talk to Brooser!
Are you a volunteer? Are you ready to prepare the best party ever?

Wait a minute! It's you I've been looking for! I heard about your adventures, and I know you're a champion. This is just what we need. What, don't you know what goes on here? We're getting ready for an Anniversary, whole Sarnaut is celebrating it.

By saying "we", I mean all members of the Holiday Committee and our chief, Solemna de Ardeur.

I've got stuff to do. If you want to help, talk to Solemna!
Are you a volunteer? Are you ready to prepare the best party ever?
Mount the anniversary horse and deliver invitations to three special guest. Report to Brooser the Snap.

I'm really sick of these formal dinners. Black ties, white ties, tuxedos, all of it look stupid on an orc. We need to throw a party party! You know, lots of food, beverages and fun! Do you like the idea? I bet you do! But wait, you have a couple of assignments to fulfil before we start.

We need to invite guests, right? Here are the invitations, here's the list of guest. Everything's simple - take the list and deliver the notes!

I will also give you a horse for speedy delivery. She's not just some hunchback horsey - she's really beautiful, strong and fast. Don't forget to feed her properly and smack her as you ride. She's the fastest of all!

One more thing. I overheard that werefoxes have grown in numbers in IMD, so run for your life, if you come across any of them!
Don't just stand there, the clock is ticking!
Nice! Let's wait for the reply... I hope the orcs can write, which I doubt.
Have you fallen off the horse? Try again then. I've got enough copies of the invitation.
Mount the anniversary horse and deliver invitations to three special guest. Report to Solemna de Ardeur.

What is trendy nowadays? Apart from you know what, people love to make idols. It's what all people need - to have someone to hope on, to copy, to follow... We need to find suitable heroes.

Here is a list of three candidates. I need you to deliver invitations to them here, in Lightwood, as fast as you can. After they send me there replies, I will have to schedule their speeches and think of a seating chart.

I will also give you a horse for speedy delivery. She's not just some hunchback horsey - she's really beautiful, strong and fast. Don't forget to feed her properly and smack her as you ride. She's the fastest of all!

One more thing. I overheard that werefoxes have grown in numbers, so run for your life, if you come across any of them!
What are you waiting for? Go, go now!
Nice! Let's wait for the reply... Come back tomorrow for more assignments.
Have you fallen off the horse? Try again then. I've got enough copies of the invitation.
Complete the quest "Tricky Invitation" and wait for another stage to start. Report to Brooser the Snap.

Everyone in the Empire will remember well the celebration of this Anniversary! Everyone will wine, dine, sing and dance! It's a major event, after all!

We don't have much time, though. The committee has scheduled two weeks only for preparation of each stage, fancy that. Do they think I have an army of assistants, or what?

No time to chat. Let's get down to business. First of all, we need to invite celebrities. Not just some second rate working class heroes, but real champions! They must be capable of entertaining other guests properly. Here's the list.

As soon as we're done, we can go on to the next stage. Don't let me down, I believe in you.
What are you waiting for? Go, go now!

Sweet! I've got all the replies I need. We don't have much room, but it is still going to be fun. Do you think I should invite the emergency medical service from "Cloud Nine"? Eh?

Now here's another task for you. We ought to have started another stage of preparations, but something unexpected happened. Listen...
Complete the quest "Tricky Invitation" and wait for another stage to start. Report to Solemna de Ardeur.

Everyone in the League will remember well the celebration of this Anniversary! Everyone will wine, dine, sing and dance! It's a major event, after all, and my impeccable elven taste is exactly what the League needs.

The whole process is accurately scheduled - two weeks for preparation of each stage. I believe we are totally on the safe side, and have more than enough time!

Now let's get down to business. First of all, we need to invite celebrities and other guests. Here's the list, my job is done here, now it's your turn. You will work as a special messenger.

As soon as we're done, we can go on to the next stage. Don't let me down, I believe in you.

There is no time to waste!
I've been revising my food list, and it looks like I will have to order more veggie stuff. Green and bio are highly popular nowadays.

Everything is done flawlessly. Guests are already arriving, and those who don't, are sending written notes. We don't have to worry about this part of the program any more.

Now, as to the next stage, we are having this force majeure thing... again!
Go to the Dead Sea, conquer power of the three Elemental totems and challenge Elemental Offspring. Collect 100 Concentrated Energies and report to Brooser the Snap.

Now we need energy. An old shaman once told me about three totems that are in the Dead Sea, just three old totems that nobody cares about... He said ancient druids installed them long before the Cataclysm, so it's not at all as primitive as it looks like... He told me the secret of extracting energy from them - they're full of it!

Here are the three Elemental Essences. They will help you call upon the power of corresponding totems. Three evil spirits will appear, and you have to defeat them all. After you do so, touch the fourth totem to summon Elemental Offspring!

I don't really know what it is, but I know how to fight it. You will see it turning into elementals, and as it does, you will have to channel the power of the totem of the same element upon it. Then power will overflow the Offspring, and you will be able to collect the extra of it. Got it? Redirect and collect!

The shaman said that it's easy... for a decent fighter, of course. I think you will do just fine.
So, how's the milking of the elementals going? I'd love to see that myself...
Great! This is enough to feed flashlights, speakers and other useful devices. Well done! I will have to think about a more important task for you!
Go to Siveria, conquer power of the three Elemental totems and challenge Elemental Offspring. Collect 100 Concentrated Energies and report to Solemna de Ardeur.

I need energy, and I've got an idea where to get it from...

An old magister once told me about three totems that are in Siveria, just three old totems that nobody cares about... He said ancient druids installed them long before the Cataclysm, so it's not at all as primitive as it looks like... He told me the secret of extracting energy from them - they're full of it!
Here are the three Elemental Essences. They will help you call upon the power of corresponding totems. Three evil spirits will appear, and you have to defeat them all. After you do so, touch the fourth totem to summon Elemental Offspring!

I don't really know what it is, but I know how to fight it. You will see it turning into elementals, and as it does, you will have to channel the power of the totem of the same element upon it. Then power will overflow the Offspring, and you will be able to collect the extra of it. The magister was sure about the safety of collecting excessive energy... but never said dealing with Elemental Offspring was safe, either.

Collect enough energy and then come back to me. There's no time to waste.
Ancient spirits, contributing to the progress... O tempora!
Great. I think this energy will be enough for my purposes. Thank you, your help is absolutely priceless.
Complete the quest "Thinking Outside the Box" and wait for another stage to start. Report to Brooser the Snap.

I've got a great idea! We need to set up a tent camp. You know, together with trade fair, street musicians, parade, all that stuff. But we need extra energy source for it.

So I came up with this idea at the Committee meeting, and guess what! They totally rejected it. They said they have no energy, and told me to stop dreaming and return to my official duties! Arrgh, am I mad!

Screw them, I though. I've got a backup plan.
I swear, if anyone tries to take away the energy, I'll show them...

We store more energy than XAES now! We need to keep it secret, though, or the Committee will audit the life out of us...

Now that we've dealt with our force majeure, let's get back to our tight schedule.
Complete the quest "Concealed Assets" and wait for another stage to start. Report to Solemna de Ardeur.

Here's the situation. We wanted to set up a tent camp. You know, together with trade fair, street musicians, parade, oh so beautiful! But then I realized that we need extra energy source for it. Novograd won't be able to grant us the supply.

My grand plan is at risk of failure. It is unacceptable. I went as far as cutting the quantity of city illumination three times, and I'm still afraid the light might go out at any moment...

Luckily, I'm on short terms with one of the wisest magisters of House de Blizare. He gave me a good hint on where to find an extra source... Would you like to hear it too?
I'm sure the next great event should be organized in one of the elven cities. There is no place in Sarnaut more beautiful that that.

We store more energy than we might need now!

Now that we've dealt with this shortage, let's get back to our tight schedule.
Complete the quest "Anniversary Safari" and wait for another stage to start. Report to Brooser the Snap.

Just look at this beast! Isn't he huge? Isn't he magnificent? Best lion breeders of the Empire brought him up specially for the Anniversary. He's well trained and can do a lot of funny tricks.

His name is Broots. He looks menacing, but in fact, he's just like a little kitten - tender, playful and even a bit sheepish. At least he used to be, before his food ration was cut by half! All because of the celebrations! "We need all the resources we can get," - they say. "No lion can eat this much," - they say. This is such a shame.

So my poor Broots got wild, naturally. He's not playful any longer, and ready to tear apart anyone who enters the cage. We need to do something, before he eats some poor citizen at the celebration...

I think I know where to get the meat...
I'd gladly let the animal into Committee, but I'm afraid, this kind of humor won't be appreciated.

Just look at him! Look at how he's eyeing you! I bet he understands who brings him food, now he's in love with you!

Let's go on with our plans now, shall we?
Obtain five pieces of fresh meat, killing Steppe Spider near Nezebgrad. Feed the lion and report to Brooser the Snap.

Broots is a wild beast, after all. Of course, he used to be on a special diet until now, but I'm sure he will gladly have some fresh raw meat. The animal that's rich in flesh around here would be... let me see... I think, it's steppe spiders that you can easily find near the city of Nezebgrad.

Kill a few, cut the meat of their bodies and bring it to the lion. I think, five will be enough for starters.

Don't wait for me to feed him. Just look, how hungry he is! No, don't be afraid, he won't eat you. He's tamed, after all... I think.
I brought him here, when he was this little, and tamed him myself.

Now I feel better, too, as if I was starving together with the poor kitty. Thank you, this is a huge relief.

He's in fact so fragile, I couldn't stand it if something would have happened to him...
Complete the quest "Taming the Lion" and wait for another stage to start. Report to Solemna de Ardeur.

Just look at this beast! Isn't he huge? Isn't he magnificent? Best lion breeders of the League brought him up specially for the Anniversary. He's well trained and can do a lot of funny tricks.

His name is Broots. He looks menacing, but in fact, he's just like a little kitten - tender, playful and even a bit sheepish. At least he used to be, before his food ration was cut by half! All because of the celebrations! "We need all the resources we can get," - they say. "No lion can eat this much," - they say. This is such a shame.

So my poor Broots got wild, naturally. He's not playful any longer, and ready to tear apart anyone who enters the cage. We need to do something, before he eats some poor citizen at the celebration...

I think I know where to get the meat...
And let them eat crops and vegetables by themselves!

Just look at him! Look at how he's eyeing you! I bet he understands who brings him food, now he's in love with you!

Let's go on with our plans now, shall we?
Obtain five pieces of fresh meat, killing Tusked Boars near Novograd. Feed the lion and report to Solemna de Ardeur.

Broots is a wild beast, after all. Of course, he used to be on a special diet until now, but I'm sure he will gladly have some fresh raw meat. The animal that's rich in flesh around here would be... let me see... I think, it's tusked boars that you can easily find near the city of Novograd.

Kill a few, cut the meat of their bodies and bring it to the lion. I think, five will be enough for starters.

Don't wait for me to feed him. Just look, how hungry he is! No, don't be afraid, he won't eat you. He's tamed, after all... I think.
I bottle-fed him when he was this little... I would give everything just to hear him purr once again...

Now I feel better, too, as if I was starving together with the poor kitty. Thank you, this is a huge relief.

He's in fact so fragile, I couldn't stand it if something would have happened to him...

Now, if you wanna help, here's the list of those who you must invite to the party.

First, it's Fith the Forester, a Blue Corporal from Igsh Military District. He's a real man, always ready to fight! Can't even remember when I last saw him without bruises on his face...

Second, it's Shildar the Wily, a Red Captain... you got me, right? That's gonna be some show, right? Don't tell anyone, though. I don't want the joke to be spoiled.

And third, it's Marianna Preminina, IMD Commissar. Real headstrong woman with an iron fist! But I can tell everyone will be glad to see her here.

All clear? To the rear! March!
h: To whom should the invitations be delivered?

t:
Of course. Here's a list of guests for you.

First, it's Timofey Gromov, a distinguished druid. He might look gloomy and thoughtful, but he is a true druid, very skillful. Kanians and Gibberlings adore his magic of Nature. Who knows, may be we have a chance to see a miracle...

Second, it's Pakhom Rogov, construction council agent. He's not very widely known, but he's pretty, so the ladies here are going to love him. We're making up a legend for him now, you know, for the ladies.

The third and the last one is Vladimir Zalesky, the League commander. A real hero, a legend for kids, he's got a few stories to tell, for sure.

Do you have any questions? No? Then I'm hoping to see all the guests here soon!
h: To whom should the invitations be delivered?

t:
Is that meat? Looks disgusting. And stinks, too. Let me have some... What are you staring at? My bro once tried to eat an Astral demon. Imagine, how hungry he was! It's a pity he couldn't. The demon fell into ashes!

Listen up now. The lion is as moody as a grumpy old man. One minute, he's calm, another minute, he roars and charges at you! So, you need to soothe him first, if you want to feed him.

If you see he's falling asleep, find courage, work up your nerve and roar at him! That'll wake him up, for sure! Don't overdo it, though. If he's too annoyed, you will have to talk to him mildly to pacify him.

As soon as he's calm, not too sleepy, not too annoyed - it's high time to feed him all your steaks. Come back to me, when you have it done.

You have brought the meat? Excellent. Hm, looks good enough... I think.

Now, our lion is as moody as a grumpy old man. One minute, he's calm, another minute, he roars and charges at you! So, you need to soothe him first, if you want to feed him.

If you see he's falling asleep, find courage, work up your nerve and roar at him! That'll wake him up, for sure! Don't overdo it, though. If he's too annoyed, you will have to talk to him mildly to pacify him, like a baby. As soon as he's calm, it's high time to feed him all your steaks. Come back to me, when you've finished.
We're having a party here! Don't go too far from here.
Flowers, and tapestry, and musicians! Just imagine, how beautiful it all will be!
Obtain the chest of Anniversary coins, stolen by Trickster, and bring it back to Brooser the Snap.

We need the chest back, the sooner the better, before the Committee finds out. A friend of mine, an old shaman, gave me this amulet once. Here, take it. It's supposed to protect you from the spirits, ruled by our thief. Its charms might have worn out, so you will probably have to run about a bit, before it starts working properly. The amulet will turn his tricks on himself, and let him return to wherever he crawled from.

Grab the chest as you see it, before anyone else does! Say, a waterfolk or a gibberling...

All coins are there, and they're safe. Whew.

I didn't count them all, of course, I've just got an eagle eye.
Complete the quest "Sneaky Thief" and wait for the final stage to start. Report to Brooser the Snap.

We've been robbed! Not just of some stuff you wouldn't even notice. A whole chest of Anniversary coins has gone missing! Brand new, freshly coined, all shiny...

At first I thought - ah, big deal! Called for the huntmasters to put their dogs on the scent. My best pathfinders, mind you! They returned all wounded, dogs with tails between their legs...

They said it was a wicked wizard. And you know what else?

The wicked wizard is merely a forestfolk. That's that. Some half-witted bogey from the woods kicked ten fully grown up men. And their dogs. Can you imagine this?

We really need to return the coins. Can you help me?

Our huntmasters were so impressed with what they saw that they immediately went to our shamans for Natural magic lessons. Fancy a brave Xadaganian with his dog in the Kingdom of Nature! I'll laugh my ears off.

Next step will be what? Elves teaching necromancy to Kanians? Aha ha ha!

That's it. All the preparations are over. The Anniversary Event is about to start. These were the crazy weeks, I admit, but I think I liked it. The chest is guarded by Yasker Hawks themselves!

There's just one last thing... Don't look at me like that, I'm giving you no tasks! It's Broots. He's sick to death to be in the cage, and I just cannot let him out like that. He won't survive in the wild nature. I cannot let him take part in the Anniversary event, either - after all this mess, he's too nervous for that.

May be you want to adopt him? He adores you, I can tell. What about me? I will survive. It's better for him.
Obtain the chest of Anniversary coins, stolen by Trickster, and bring it back to Solemna de Ardeur.

It's evident that it was a forestfolk who stole the treasure. Huntmasters have already tracked him down, but failed to capture him. He turned out to be nobody else but Trickster himself - a mighty wizard of the forestfolks tribe.

The only genius of forestfolks is committing crimes. How sad can it be? I'm sure you can defeat him, if you choose to. I have to warn you, though, don't underestimate his powers. He knows the Nature of the Lightwood better than anyone else. The huntmasters said he summoned some forest spirits to attack them. My guess is that he charmed them somehow.

Here's a special amulet. It's supposed to protect you from the spirits, ruled by our thief. Its charms might have worn out, so you will probably have to run about a bit, before it starts working properly. The amulet will turn his tricks on himself, and let him return to wherever he crawled from.

Come back soon.
I'm writing a petition to Aidenus for a decent magical protection of our treasures.

Excellent! We've got the chest, Trickster learned his lesson. I hope he will never go for a robbery again.

Thank you!
Complete the quest "Sneaky Thief" and wait for the final stage to start. Report to Solemna de Ardeur.

We've been robbed! Not just of some stuff you wouldn't even notice. A whole chest of Anniversary coins has gone missing! Brand new, freshly coined, all shiny...

At first I thought - ah, big deal! Called for the huntmasters to put their dogs on the scent. My best pathfinders, mind you! They returned all wounded, dogs with tails between their legs...

They said these were evil spirits. And you know what else?
The evil spirits turned out to be forestfolks and waterfolks. That's that. Some half-witted bogeys from the woods kicked ten fully grown up men. And their dogs. Can you imagine this?

You're our last hope. Please, help us return the treasure...

That's it. All the preparations are over. The Anniversary Event is about to start. These were the crazy weeks, I admit, but I think I liked it. The chest it tightly locked, and the lock is charmed by Aidenus himself. I'm not sure what the charms do to potential thieves. It might either incinerate them or turn them into ginger-haired haregons...

There's just one last thing... Don't look at me like that, I'm giving you no tasks! It's Broots. He's sick to death to be in the cage, and I just cannot let him out like that. He won't survive in the wild nature. I cannot let him take part in the Anniversary event, either - after all this mess, he's too nervous for that.

May be you want to adopt him? He adores you, I can tell. What about me? I will survive. It's better for him.

Besides, I'm sure he's going to like Astral travels!
Find Marianna Lopatina in the Recruitment Center.

Attention! Attention! Brave adventurers, heroes and defenders of the Empire! Famous traveler Marianna Lopatina needs your help! If distant journeys and terrible mysteries don't scare you, she's waiting for you in the Recruitment Center!
Hi! Well, at least someone responded. You can't imagine what a horrible thing I dug out...

During the recent expedition, I found a strange clay tablet in the June Ruins. It was crumbled, but I could piece it together and read something. Have a look: "pro...phe..." - that's prophecy! And then: "...day" - that's doomsday! "Death an... ition..." - that's death and perdition! Yet the most horrible thing is the date at the end. Look at the numbers - it's quite soon! According to the June prophecy, our world is going to end in less than a month, and we know nothing about it!
But that's not all. There was a skull next to the tablet. I think the skull belonged to that very prophet. It had a hat on, and when I tried it on, I saw what he'd seen! Try it on and I think you'll see it too!
If you don't see anything, then either I'm a prophet myself... or I'm nuts and hallucinating. Bah, I don't know which is worse.
Well, you see it? Doom and gloom... We must find a way to avert the end of the world!
Pass Marianna Lopatina's test and wait until she finishes looking for assistants.

Well, you with me? Excellent! But I have to test you first. Sorry, but that's my rule: I make all my companions pass a little exam. I'm sick and tired of dragging helpless braggarts out of pitfalls and from under rocks, scraping them off walls and washing their remains off my clothes... Now, that's not a slight against you! I believe you really are a true hero. Which means you can pass my test in a jiffy.
Here's another thing. The doomsday is not a joke. The more people we can gather, the better. Wait a day or two while I'm looking for companions... But no longer than a week!
Don't be afraid, the test is easy. At least it's easy for a true adventurer!

Are there no true adventurers left in the Empire? Imagine that, I couldn't find any! Some ran away with supersonic speed once they put the hat on. Others asked how much I'd pay them for their help. Others could hardly escape my golems... Looks like it's just you and me. We can't wait any longer. Let's get to it!
Defeat the golems summoned by Marianna Lopatina.

The test is simple. I'll show you some of the dangers that await an adventurer in the June Tombs. Although the Junes vanished long ago, their golems have kept their watch for centuries and even millennia. Those who are not ready to deal with them had better stay home. So, shall we begin? Let me know when you are ready.
The ancient tombs are no place for the weak. Whatever you touch tries to behead you. Meanwhile, it's common knowledge that no head is worse than one!
Not bad. I wouldn't think twice about setting out into the deepest catacombs with someone like you by my side. Looks like we do have a chance to save the world!
Test the device and wait for Marianna Lopatina to finish searching for "alternatives."

Looks like I found a way... No, not to save the world, but at least to find out what was written on the tablet. I already did the difficult part: I obtained the device and found out how to use it. After I explain it all to you, we'll get down to business. Meanwhile, I'll look for an alternative option. The situation is serious, and we may need to resort to... extreme measures.
Time is running short, but we mustn't rush things either. We need to find out what's what and what exactly threatens Sarnaut, not run around without purpose like headless chickens.
Well, I found an alternative. Oh, I really didn't want to resort to this thing... However, the end of the world is close at hand, and we're still stuck where we are!
Go to the gutter, use the Semiotic Restorer to collect 20 Grains of Wisdom and give them to Marianna Lopatina.

While you were competing with the golems, I went to see my acquaintance, who is a genius inventor. I don't know how sane he is but, according to his theory, all that was ever written or said is eternally stored in a special world of words and symbols. He invented a special device that extracts lost texts from that world. If this thing works, we can restore the crumbled tablet and read the prophecy!
Here, take the device. I already set it up to restore the tablet. But you'll need a friendly assistant. One of you has to turn on the device and project... What did the professor call them... Iconosemiolo... That's a freaking tongue-twister! To put it simply, the obscure meanings from the world of words. As your hands are busy holding the device, someone else has to research them to find the grains of wisdom. How do I know what they look like? I don't, I'm just repeating what the professor said! But I think you won't mistake them for anything else. Gather some twenty pieces - I think that'll do. Be careful, though: the professor said there were monsters even in the world of texts. If they show up, be on guard! And better get to a safe place. Go to that ravine, for instance. Or, Light forbid, some passers-by can get hurt.

If the device works, we'll be able to restore and read any of the lost books, be it the second volume of Evenings on a Farm near Molotovka or the broken tablets of Aitzaupalotle's Admonitions for His Sons. Let alone all the ancient settlements and treasures we could find... Isn't that awesome?

Here they are, shining Grains of Wisdom! Let's see what we've got there!
Damn... I don't know whether to laugh or cry! See, now we know for sure the number of times each June symbol was used on the tablet, the number of punctuation marks, the total length of the text, the rules of consonant interchange - everything except what exactly is written on it. Looks like we'll never know what exactly Aitzaupalotle had willed to his sons and where he buried his gold. And time is running out... How are we going to save the world?
Charge the Wand of Summoning the Dead and wait until it is ready for use.

Dealing with the dead is dangerous, scary and simply impolite. But that's our last chance to find out how to save the world: we have to summon the prophet's spirit! Oh, I really didn't want to obtain this artifact! But I did it, and now it's in our hands, just like the June's skull. Now we have to charge it with Sparks... Don't look so scared! I'm not Tep, after all! I mean Sparks of animals. I'll explain how to do it. The charging will take some time, though, and we're running out of it...
A dreadful thing, isn't it? Don't even ask me how I obtained it.
See the ominous shining the wand's gems give off? It's ready for use. It's time we disturbed the peace of the dead.
Charge the Wand with the life force of 15 animals of your level.

Here is the Wand. Can you feel how cold it is? Like a grave. To summon the June's spirit, we'll need to kindle it with warmth that we'll have to take from living creatures. I feel bad for the critters, but if the doomsday comes, I'll feel a lot worse for everybody.
Here's what needs to be done. First, draw a circle on the ground with this Wand. Then do anything to lure any wild animal inside that circle. But not some small rodent! The stronger the creature, the better! Inside the circle, the animal will become rigid. Touch it with the Wand here, between the eyes. It will die, and the Wand will get a little warmer. Fifteen animals' lives will do to bring back the deceased... for a time.
Human Sparks would do the job too, I guess... But we're not some monsters, after all!

The Wand is getting warmer... And that warmth seems to be even scarier than the cold. Now we have to wait until the Wand assimilates the Sparks taken from the animals. Like a boa digesting prey... Brrr!
Summon the June prophet's spirit and protect it from the ghosts.

The Wand is ready, we can begin the ritual. Move towards those hills, away from unwanted eyes, and touch your skull with the Wand. The spirit should show up, but not alone: hungry restless souls will come rushing to the call of a warm living body. Don't let them tear the ghost apart. Afterwards, get back to me, and we'll finally question him.
I've seen plenty of ancient skulls and I've unearthed lots of dreadful artifacts, but this sorcery gives me the creeps.

There he is. Let's see what he has to say!

Wait... What is this?! What is he babbling?

Unbelievable! So much effort only to summon a spirit that only speaks June!
Set up the automatic Versatile Translator.

Never mind, I have an ace up my sleeve. You find lots of stuff while digging around in the ruins! Here, look: an automatic Versatile Translator. A unique device made by some unknown person using some technology that no longer exists. It'll easily translate the prophet's words for us, all we need is to set it up.
The translator is powered by the elements: fire, ice and lightning. When switched on, the device will begin to charge each of the elements. Watch the indicators: if the charge for any of the elements reaches ten, the device will overheat and might blow up! Next: those three buttons allow resetting the charge. The first button reduces the fire charge, the second one the lightning charge, and the third one the ice charge. Also, pressing any button reduces the charge for one of the other elements, the greater one.
Use these buttons to carefully adjust the charges until each of the three elements has reached the charge of five. Then push the big button and the white light will go on. When all five are on, the device is set! Is it clear or should I repeat the instructions? I think I might have gotten confused myself. I've had it with these inventors...
Set it up fast and let's question the prophet! The world is about to perish, and we have no idea how to save it!
Ready! Good job! It's time we found out how to save the world!
Ask the June Prophet about the End of the World.
Finally, we'll know what's what! Come on, let's ask him!
At least I hope we have a little time left...

Unbelievable. So much effort and running around - and all for just a toy! Of course, it's good the world is no longer threatened, but trying to brag about such deeds will make a laughing stock out of you! Alas... Well, at least take the hat, it's no good to me. I'll go look for Jahmanukti's tomb. Good luck! We may meet again!
It's not easy to handle this one!
The final fight is the toughest one!
Looks like this time we'll have to save the world by ourselves. Unless you decide to flee, of course. In that case I'll make it alone!
h: Ask Marianna if she has found any assistants.

t: Looks like the world needs saving once again... You with me?
So much effort! Finally, we'll find out whatever he has predicted!
h: Ask about the End of the World

t: How come you can't see him? He's right there. Squint your eyes, bow your head, wink... See him now?
Yes, I've found an alternative option... However, touching it gives me the creeps.
Yes, the Wand is ripe. It is glowing... With darkness. I've seen a lot, but this stuff makes my skin crawl.
h: Ask if the Wand is ready

t: Hey, what the hell! What kind of help is it? One assistant is clumsier than the other! One carries bits of astralium in his pockets and then complains about some outgrowth. Another one tried to use the seventh page of the Great Mage's Diary to kindle a fire. The third... May he rest in peace... Argh! I've found the translator, here it is. Don't lose it again!
h: Ask for a new Versatile Translator

t: A new one? You think there's another thing like that in Sarnaut? I hope not! How can one lose such items at all? Can you imagine what can happen if it gets into the wrong hands? Luckily, I noticed it and picked it up. Here, take it and don't lose it again!
h: Ask for a new Wand of Summoning the Dead

t:
What?! That's the only prototype! Where am I going to get another one?
Consider yourself lucky that, while some keep losing unique devices, others find them. Here it is. And see that you don't drop it again!
h: Ask for a new Semiotic Restorer

t: A new one? You think there's another thing like that in Sarnaut? I hope not! How can one lose such items at all? Can you imagine what can happen if it gets into the wrong hands? Luckily, I noticed it and picked it up. Here, take it and don't lose it again!
h: Ask for a new Wand of Summoning the Dead

t: Just don't pass out. It's not exactly an optimistic picture.
Find Marianna Lopatina in the Lightwood.

I'll go look for Jahmanukti's tomb. Good luck! We may meet again!
Use the June portal on Gipat to get to the Crossroads.

Ha ha! Relax, I'm kidding! Of course I can write, and I know a lot about this document.
But we will talk about it later and in a different place - an amazing one, trust me. They call it the Crossroads, a small allod where you will make the first steps towards the new Revelation.
Well, I suppose you have a lot of questions. I will answer one now so you stop thinking about it again and again. Yes, I am the Director. It was me who used the drakes on Gipat to mess with your head. And believe me, it wasn't the last of me.
Now go to the village, find the June portal, activate it to teleport to the Crossroads and meet me there.
See you!
Hello! Haven't seen you for ages! Ha ha...

So, you are good at navigation. I'm going to open a portal for you, as you are going to travel a lot. The truth is not waiting for you around the corner. You are going to spend time searching for it. I hope you already learned this lesson on Gipat.
You can bind to this location for returning here later.
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
These ruins can transport you in a number of locations.
Ask the guide about your future adventures. You can only ask three questions.

As you can see, I'm not an innkeeper. I'm rather a guide, a lead... But less talk of me, let's get back to business.
It's time to dive into the secrets of the past and learn why everything is so fragile and so beautiful in this world. And another fascinating pastime is an attempt to change the course of nature.
Believe me, everything can be changed - any event, even it happened a long time ago. All you need is to go back into the past. You don't know how to do that?
I'm not saying it's easy. You have to tear the fabric of reality, to reshape it... It takes lots of efforts.
You can ask me three questions to get a grasp of what awaits you and why it's so important. And of course, you will get your answers.
Fine. Now you know enough to travel in time.
Ask the guide about your future adventures. You can only ask three questions.

Fine. Now you know enough to travel in time.
Give one handful of the Ashes of the Past to Gorislav if you want to use the Whirlpool of Time.

As I told you, the time needs to be satiated. The Ashes of the Past are its favorite course. If you want to ride the waves of time, you have to feed it. Bring me a handful of the Ashes if you want to use the Whirlpool of Time. You will have to visit the Astral Graveyard to get them. If you want to dive into the Whirlpool of Time right now, give me a handful of the Ashes.
Do you have the Ashes of the Past?
These are perfect! The Whirlpool of Time awaits!
Give one handful of the Ashes of the Past to Gorislav if you want to use the Whirlpool of Time.

As I told you, the time needs to be satiated. The Ashes of the Past are its favorite course. If you want to ride the waves of time, you have to feed it.
Bring me a handful of the Ashes if you want to use the Whirlpool of Time. You will have to visit the Astral Graveyard to get them.
If you want to dive into the Whirlpool of Time right now, give me a handful of the Ashes.
Do you have the Ashes of the Past?
Great. Now the Whirlpool of Time can send you back into the past Kirah.
Ask Gorislav about changing the past.

Now that we changed the events of March 910, we can go further. Your actions reshaped the fabric of reality, and it turned out that certain events never happened. Do you understand what I am talking about? Ask me more if something is still unclear.
Go to the Astral Graveyard, get 10 handfuls of the Ashes and bring them to Gorislav on the Crossroads.

As you know, in this new version of reality the demons have failed to capture Kirah at one stroke, so they had to change their tactics. They are throwing more and more forces into the battle, still willing to destroy Kirah.
But now we have a chance to save the complete allod, not a small part of it! Especially if we stop demons from destroying the meteorite ore hidden in the depths of the allod. Let's see if we manage to do it. Everything depends on you now.
The new task requires you to eliminate several prominent figures of the past. You will need more Ashes of the Past to do that. Go to the Astral Graveyard and get 10 handfuls. Should you succeed, you won't have to spend the Ashes to use the Whirlpool of Time anymore.
Have you stockpiled some Ashes for the future? Or for the past, ha?
Great. Now you can go back to Kirah.
Save Kirah from destruction and report back to Gorislav.

I'm sending you to Kirah, into the 5th of March, year 910 - the day when the League and the Empire forces tried to hold back the demonic invasion. You won't need to prove them anything, they will put absolute trust in you.
Make use of this opportunity and save Kirah. Remember that the main supply of the meteorite ore is located not inside the mine, but to the north of it. This place will be the first priority target for demons. You must stop them.
I recommend you to speak with your old friends first. Yasker or Eniel will tell you what to do.
Did you manage to save Kirah?
You did it! I know it wasn't easy. Still, our enemy came up with a countermove!
Ask Gorislav about the threat from the future and the new tactics.

Yes, I know everything. I know of the mysterious demon that attacked you. I know of your death. You see, I know quite a lot.
Does it mean that I'm omnipotent? We will talk about it later. Someday in the future, if a time of prosperity finally comes. For now, the future represents only a threat for us.
So let's discuss our new tactics.
I hope I will help you understand what's going on.
Now you know a lot more. I just need to find a new task for you.
Get the Charm of the Astral Silver by completing quests on the June Tomb Isle, then return to Gorislav Gipitsky at the Crossroads.

The portal will now send you to another Astral isle called the June Tomb.
In the middle of it you will see an ancient June pyramid. It was built over the place where the Great Dragon Hunter of Junes found his eternal rest.
The restless spirit of the Hunter is still wandering around the tomb. It's difficult to explain, but the most important thing for us is that the spirit can give you a special Charm of the Astral Silver.
I see you want to know how the Charm is related to the Astral Silver and to the powers of the Great Martyrs. And maybe you are curious about the fact that this thousand years old Charm will help you defeat the demon created in the future?
One day you will know the answers. But it won't happen before you get the Charm.
You will get your answers later. First you must find the charm.

Here it is. A part of the Seal...
Oops! It seems my tongue is too long for my teeth! Do you want to ask me anything? Are you wondering what the Seal is?
Ha ha! The story becomes more intriguing! Isn't it great?
Ask Gorislav about the mystery of the Great Mages.

Okay, let's be serious. I'm going to tell you a secret related to your next task. This is a great secret indeed, and the task you are up for is a great one, too, in its own way.
Come closer. I'll whisper you something about the Great Mages...
Well? Isn't this world full of surprises?!
Now you know the secret of Great Mages' immortality. Let's go back to our concerns!
Find the key to the Secret Cave, enter it and retrieve the Dragon's Heart.

So, I want you to bring me the Dragon's Heart. Consider this task an opportunity to prove that you trust me. I'll explain everything later, the way to infinite power will be revealed to you.
I'll send you into the period of time when the demon attack is driven off. The League and the Empire can take a breath, and Yasker and Eniel are proceeding with their secret mission. They are ready to entrust it to you, a powerful and devoted traveler from the future. Speak with them and go to the Secret Cave, where the Heart is hidden. It is guarded by Nezeb Falcons under Vlad's command. You won't be able to avoid fighting them. But that's the only way to get the key to the Secret Cave.

Actually, it doesn't matter if we met before or not. During my adventures I've met a lot of new friends.
All you need to know is that Gorislav sent me. You can think of me as of his daughter. It's not entirely true, but quite close. I'm here by his order.

Now return to Gorislav. He will reward you and tell you another fascinating story!
My daddy loves telling stories!

Well, what should I tell you?
Something about Sarn? Let's keep it for the future.
Who is Nih? You'll know eventually...
I'd like to end my story of the Great Mages and the secret of their immortality with a small riddle. Here it is.
We know that there are three substances resistant to the Astral: meteorite ore, the Great Dragon remains and the Great Mages, whose immortality is ensured by the blood of the Great Dragons.
The meteorite ore is alien to our world, it has been brought here by an meteor collided with our lands ages ago, when no one lived here except the Great Dragons.
The Great Dragons don't belong to our world either. They came here from afar. Maybe that's why they can resist the Astral.
And now, the Great Mages, who drink the blood of the Great Dragons. Is there any connection? Think about it!
Are you bored? Waiting for your reward? Don't you care about the secrets of our world? Huh! A couple years ago I was just like you!

Return to old Kirah and use the Ashes of the Past on three key figures of the Empire: Yasker, Negus Tot and Fang the Nomadic, then return to the Servant of Time on Kirah.

If you have the Ashes of the Past, we can discuss our plans.
The Whirlpool of Time will send you a hundred years back, into the 3rd of March, year 910. What happened on Kirah on that day? Right - the night of Astral Portals.
The League Army landed on the Imperial allod Kirah in order to capture its meteorite ore supply. The best warriors fought there. And almost all of them perished in the battle. The day after, demons arrived and the Astral started to devour Kirah... You should read about it if you are interested in details.
Just imagine - what if the battle between the League and the Empire never took place? What if the both sides knew of the danger of the demonic invasion?
Let's try and see what's going to happen. You are returning to the old Kirah and try to change the past. It won't be easy.
Three persons in the Imperial army can change the course of the events: younger Yasker, the future Leader of the Empire, Negus Tot, Zem scientist and friend of Nefer Ur, and Fang the Nomadic, Wrokag's great grandfather. A handful of the Ashes of the Past should be used on each of them to make them believe that you are from the future. Don't be surprised if they won't pay attention at first. Your goal is to persuade them.
The fourth handful of the Ashes will send you into the past through the Whirlpool of Time. When you complete this task, find my assistant at the Imperial camp on Kirah. He will give you further instructions.
Have you persuaded Yasker, Negus Tot and Fang?
Great. Now, to our main goal.
Return to old Kirah and use the Ashes of the Past on key figures of the League: Eniel de Ardeur, the Fidget Family and Lazarus Valir, then return to the Servant of Time on Kirah.

If you have the Ashes of the Past, we can discuss our plans.
The Whirlpool of Time will send you a hundred years back, into the 3rd of March, year 910. What happened on Kirah on that day? Right - the night of Astral Portals.

The following persons in the League army can change the course of the events: the Great Mage Eniel de Ardeur, the Fidget Family, the ancestors of Froddy the Fidget, and Lazarus Valirsky of the noble Valir family. A handful of the Ashes of the Past should be used on each of them to make them believe that you are from the future. Don't be surprised if they won't pay attention at first. Your goal is to persuade them.
The fourth handful of the Ashes will send you into the past through the Whirlpool of Time. When you complete this task, find my assistant at the League camp on Kirah. He will give you further instructions.
Have you persuaded Eniel, the Fidgets and Lazarus?
Great. Now, to our main goal.

Wait, I'll drink some water. My throat is parched because of your insane stories...
Well... Should I believe you or not? Oh, I feel dizzy... Was it just water I drank?
h: Use the Ashes of Time and tell about the future

t: Waters of Time are ready to send you to the past...

Go to the Astral Graveyard and use the Emanation of Death to fire the braziers, then use the altar to summon the undead. Collect 4 handfuls of the Ashes of the Past, then return to Gorislav on the Crossroads.

Ashes of the Past! A magic substance that keeps the memories of the events and sometimes allows changing it. You know, when you die, you will turn into a handful of the Ashes, too. The wind will scatter them and no one will ever be able to put these particles of your life together... very sad, isn't it?
Astral Graveyard is a desolate, swampy allod where the Great Dragon of Gipat experimented on the draconid creation. His early attempts were unsuccessful - only a bunch of undead creatures arose. But the good news is that their Ashes are well preserved, so you can collect them.
Use the June Portal on the Crossroads to get to the Graveyard and fight the undead creatures. Of course, not every one of them will bring you the Ashes of the Past - this substance is hard to find. But you should be able to get Emanations of Death from them which can be used to summon more powerful undead. The altar located in the center of the allod is surrounded by braziers. Use the Emanations to light them up. The more braziers you set on fire, the stronger creatures will spawn and the higher your chance to loot the Ashes will be.

The Great Dragon had to reshape the past, too, in order to create draconids.
He changed his personal past - it was the most difficult thing to do.
Aha, you managed to get the Ashes of the Past! Great news that makes me optimistic.
These ancient June ruins are overflowing with magic...
Use the ruins to teleport to one of the destination points.
Kill the ancient treant named Mudril in Sunscatter Forest and return to Liho the Nomadic.

Mudril is the name of a wise old treant that lives in Sunscatter Forest. He is much admired by the druids and the animists, and he even commands the beasts of the forest to protect their camp. Well, we can't just let this continue, can we?
We already tried diplomacy. Yes, I know, that is not usually the way of the Orcs, but he would have been an invaluable ally. Unfortunately he's determined to help those pansies. He says their mission is more noble or something.
So, here's a new task for you. Go into Sunscatter Forest and kill Mudril. He must die! But I warn you - even a shaman of your strength will have trouble taking him down. He is hundreds of years old and incredibly strong. Find some of our comrades to help you out.
That treant has to die! If he had sided with us he could have lived, but instead he chose the filthy League.
So, it is finally done! Good job, you make the shamans proud.
Kill Fangourne and report your victory to Ziva the Nomadic.

It's time for you to face a real threat.
His name is Fangourne  and he lives in the middle of the Shadowy Mire. He is a giant cursed treant, and to subdue him is to conquer the worst nature has to offer.
You should know one more thing.  Legend has it that this treant is the reason that the allod has not been swallowed by the Astral. I don't believe it myself,
 but if all that garbage is true then the allod will be destroyed when he dies.
If not, then I'll finally be proven right.
Did you manage to take the old treant down?

You killed Fangourne? Good job! I can see we're still here, so that means he wasn't fending off the Astral after all. And now you have conquered two enemies. The first one is Fangourne, and the second one is fear - the fear of the consequences of your actions.
Remember that lesson well - it is better to regret what has been done than what hasn't!
Kill Shersto the ogre chief in the Frostpaw Hills and return to the Leafy Family.

The Imperial shamans' camp is located on the other side of the Kingdom of Nature in the Frostpaw Hills. It's surrounded by large ogre guards. They're complete idiots, but they're also rather dangerous. The weakness of the shamans is quite apparent, is it not?
If they weren't afraid of us, they wouldn't have to keep those things around to protect them! We need to demolish these forces immediately. The leader of the ogres is named Shersto, and he lives in the northern parts of the hills. If we manage to defeat him, the ogres will lose spirit and flee, abandoning the Imperial shamans.
So, is your task clear? Go kill Shersto immediately! But make sure to bring some friends - for all his lack of brains, he's still quite tough!
Orcs and ogres, they're quite suited to each other! They're both ugly and barbaric!
Hurray! Shersto is dead! The animists and the druids have prevailed!
Destroy Fangourne and report your victory to Bogdan Kochakov.

The Shadowy Mire is an awful and dangerous place. It is a blight on the Kingdom of Nature! In the midst of this evil is a cursed treant named Fangourne. He is the root of this disease!
However, there are also rumors that he is the one protecting the Kingdom from the Astral. There are even rumors that he is a descendant of the Great Tree. But those who say such things are blasphemous! Such a thing could never happen.
Yet... I have found myself afraid of these rumors for a long time. They have prevented me from destroying Fangourne for years. Perhaps you could gather a group of fellow wardens and do what I could not.
Clean water, fields of green grass, and the bright sun. These are the only things that should be in the Kingdom - there is no place for evil!
Fangourne... is destroyed? And nothing has happened to the Kingdom? This is wonderful! I should not have been fearful of this rumor for so long. Now this world will finally begin to heal!
Kill 10 Primal Boars and return to Ziva the Nomadic.

The enemy is always dangerous. Remember that while you are hunting your prey, you can learn a lot from them at the same time. If you want to go further along the trail of the hunter, I can give you a new challenge.
The evil boars that live around here should be perfect for your next target. They will throw themselves into the fight and attack until the very end, just as you should! You should observe their actions and learn from their tenacity.
You can charge at them, or you can strike first, unexpectedly. It doesn't matter. In the hunt there are no rules - this isn't a Goblinball championship. All that matters is one's skill in battle and the will to live. Whoever survives is right. Now go out into the Kingdom and prove you have learned this lesson.
The great hunt... I could repeat these words over and over! They warm my heart.
Good job. Just remember to keep fighting. Always act as though you are on a hunt, and only then can you truly live.
